model.name: qwen2.5:14b
model.purpose: inference observations, no training or semantic grading

guarantees: external_knowledge + missing reliable local evidence only
volatile TTL cache; durable source metadata and content hash only
limits: Wikipedia ja/en only; no general Web/news/product search
publication date unknown in built-in backend
rule-based entities/relevance; conservative false negatives and homonyms remain
model entailment, contradiction handling and temporal paraphrases not guaranteed; initial live smoke used a future-tense description for a 2026 broadcast
obvious injection patterns rejected, not a complete natural-language injection detector
DNS and in-flight blocking reads may exceed the shared wall budget
verification_environment: Windows; full suite outside network-restricted sandbox for existing loopback IPC tests; TEMP/TMP set to repository work/test-temp
